# Leave Approval — Service Notes

Collected from the HR operations workshop on 12 March.

## Notifications

- On approval, a confirmation mail goes to the applicant **and** to the named substitute.
- On rejection, only the applicant is notified, and the manager must supply a reason.

## Escalation

- If the manager does not decide in time, the request escalates to the division head.
- Escalated requests keep their original submission date for reporting.

## Reporting

- HR pulls a monthly absence report on the first working day of the month.
